excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

escalation_rule.trigger: restart only when the returned selection has exact=false
escalation_rule.restart: each attempt starts a new count-space B&B search from all roots; no frontier or work is reused
escalation_rule.stop: execute the first exact selection; K4096 is the hard cap
escalation_rule.accounting: sum actual work reported by every attempted search, including all failed lower-budget restarts

reference.accounting: actual reported work from one K4096 call per frame

protocol.arrival_model: independent class-wise Poisson arrivals using stream key aligned-frame:{seed}:{coordinate}
protocol.common_tape_rule: construct one tape for each (lanes, load, seed) and pass its exact contents to adaptive and K4096 reference runs
protocol.online_information: each selector attempt receives only current released queues, lanes, fixed catalogue, and the attempt budget
protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames, FIFO within class, with arrivals during a frame eligible at the next frame boundary
protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at 600 seconds and drain the common finite tape to completion
registered_gate: the adaptive final selection is exact in every visited frame
adaptive and K4096 reference frame actions are exactly identical
adaptive and reference per-job flow sequences are exactly identical
charged adaptive LP calls are strictly below reference in every case
charged adaptive matrix cells are strictly below reference in every case
both charged work totals are also strictly below reference in aggregate
all jobs complete and queue recursion, FIFO decomposition, and every attempt certificate are valid

expected_work.selector_attempts: reported from actual adaptive restarts and frames

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution-integrity checks fail
decision_rule.EXACTNESS_ESCALATION_PASS: every adaptive frame is exact and identical to the K4096 reference, and charged adaptive LP calls and matrix cells are strictly smaller in every R/load case and in aggregate
decision_rule.EXACTNESS_ESCALATION_WORK_FAIL_STOP: execution is valid but one or more registered exactness, identity, or strict-work gates fail

protocol.claim_boundary: A registered finite-horizon development comparison on eight fresh Poisson seeds per load for synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 models.  It tests fresh-root budget escalation on these tapes only; it is not an all-queue result, stability proof, physical multi-GPU measurement, or deployment decision.
protocol.prohibited: post-result changes to seeds, horizon, loads, budget schedules, reference, or endpoints; treating restarts as cumulative search; ordered-action or count-vector enumeration; future-arrival access; paper or README edits

limitations: The finite seed roster cannot establish an all-queue guarantee.
Wall-clock selector timing is diagnostic and is not a scientific gate.
Fresh-root retries intentionally charge repeated search work.
next_step: Preserve this registered outcome without changing seeds, schedules, reference accounting, or gates.
